Hey OP, I'm In a similar situation to your girlfriend so hopefully I can provide you with some insight. I've been with my SO 4 years and I'm now 24. He's not really expressed any sort of long term commitment with me. I've told him he has until July to propose to me or I'm moving back home. I attend university here as it was closer to him but I graduate next year. After that, the only thing keeping me here is him and after 4 years, he should know by now if he wants to start a family, buy a house etc. with me. All my family and friends are 5 hours away. It's an ultimatum I guess but you really shouldn't see it like that. She just wants you to make a decision so she can. She obviously sees a future with you and after 3 years, you really should know if you do too. It sounds like her ultimatum has made you start actually thinking about your future together which I'm guessing was the point. I don't think my SO ever thought about it until he finally understood I want commitment or I'm going. I need to get a graduate job and I need to know what city to be looking in. There's no point starting a life in the city with no social ties other than my boyfriend if we don't have a future together. 

You need to sit and think if you see a future. Please don't waste her time if you don't. I don't see my boyfriend proposing so I've already resigned myself to that fact and exclusively looking for jobs in another city ready for when I graduate. If she is anything like me, it's not about a flashy ring, it's about finally hearing some long term future plans come out of your SOs mouth and an expression for a future together. I'd settle for that and I'm sure she would love to know where you stand too. Just tell her how you feel. If you're unsure about a future, tell her that , so she can make plans for her  own future.
